newsitem.title: UK: US STOCKS MIXED TO LOWER IN LONDON, AWAITING DATA.
newsitem.headline: US STOCKS MIXED TO LOWER IN LONDON, AWAITING DATA.

text.p: U.S. stocks were mixed to weaker in London in thin trading on Wednesday as European investors awaited key inflation and retail sales data, due before Wall Street opens.
The Dow lost 101.27 points on Tuesday to close at 7,760.84, the lowest level in three weeks.
"Europeans have not been heavily involved. People want to wait and see if this market stabilises," said one London broker. "We're waiting on the PPI (producer price index) and retail sales figures."
According to a Reuters survey of economists, the PPI is expected to show a rise 0.1 percent in July, while retail sales are expected to have risen 0.7 percent.
The figures are due for release at 1230 GMT.

September S&P 500 futures were down 2.85 points to 924.80 on Globex at 1015 GMT and September long bond futures were down 5/32 to 112-10/32, pointing to a lower start on Wall Street, although the figures could influence the open.

Among individual stocks, major pharmaceutical shares bounced back in London on bargain hunting, dealers said. Shares in Merck and Co Inc were up $3/8 to $94-1/4. Shares in Pfizer Inc added $1/4 to $53-1/2.
But most technology shares were down between $1/8 and $1/4, albeit on light volume.
Shares in International Business Machines Corp and Digital Equipment Corp each slipped $1/4 to $103-3/8 and $45-5/8, respectively.
